title: ESAB Introduces Dueler™ EHL 1500, Its First Handheld Laser Welder
summary: ESAB introduces Dueler™ EHL 1500, an air-cooled handheld laser welding system with PreciDrive™ wire feeding and intuitive touchscreen controls.
body_markdown:
**A new integrated system expands ESAB’s portfolio into handheld laser welding, pairing an intuitive user experience with the speed and precision fabricators need.**


ESAB is entering the handheld laser welding market with the introduction of the Dueler™ EHL 1500, the company’s first laser welding system. Built for fabricators who need real performance without the setup complexity of traditional laser systems, Dueler integrates a 1,500-watt laser power source, ESAB’s PreciDrive™ wire-feeding technology and a touchscreen interface into a single, air-cooled unit. No external water chiller. No separate components to manage.


*“The Dueler EHL 1500 represents an important expansion of the ESAB portfolio,”* said Peter Burchfield, vice president of global products at ESAB *. “As we continue to invest in technologies that help our customers work more efficiently and confidently, handheld laser welding gives us an opportunity to bring new capabilities to the market. Building on the arc welding expertise and customer relationships that have defined ESAB for generations, we drew on that experience to create a product that is easy to work with, featuring a compact, integrated design with a built-in feeder, gas bottle holder, gun holder, cable management, and storage box. It also has an intuitive HMI that resonates with welders’ experience and know-how, and it was designed specifically around customers’ applications and working environments.”*


On applications where weld appearance, heat management and throughput matter, laser welding has a clear edge. Dueler welds up to four times faster than TIG and up to twice as fast as MIG — and its focused laser beam puts heat exactly where it needs to go, reducing distortion, minimizing burn-through and cutting down on post-weld grinding and cleanup.


**Dueler EHL 1500 at a Glance**


- **Integrated, air-cooled design —** The laser power source, wire feeder and controls are housed in one compact system. No external water chiller required.
- **Adjustable output from 150 to 1,500 watts —** Handles everything from thin-gauge sheet metal to material up to 6.5 mm thick.
- **ESAB PreciDrive™ wire feeding —** Consistent filler-metal delivery for reliable, repeatable weld quality.
- **Intuitive touchscreen with manual and synergic modes —** Experienced welders can dial in their own parameters; newer operators can get productive quickly using factory-programmed settings for common metals.
- **Lightweight torch design —** Built for comfort during extended use on the shop floor.


**Another Option for Fabrication Teams**


The Dueler EHL 1500 is designed to complement MIG and TIG welding—not replace them. It gives fabrication teams another option for applications where lower heat input, weld appearance and faster cycle times matter most. The system is suited for a range of environments, including general fabrication, automotive, railcar, HVAC, food and beverage, hard surfacing and cladding—operations where weld quality and throughput have a direct effect on productivity.


Safety is part of the complete system. The Dueler EHL 1500 meets applicable laser safety requirements and ships with a certified ESAB laser welding helmet and a full set of accessories to support safe setup and operation from day one.


With the Dueler EHL 1500, ESAB is extending its welding, filler metal and wire-feeding expertise into handheld laser welding. It’s a continued investment for ESAB’s evolution as premiere industrial compounder and another way to help fabricators improve productivity, control quality and respond to the demands of modern production.


The[Dueler EHL 1500](https://esab.com/us/nam_en/products-solutions/product/welding-equipment/handheld-laser-welders-lbw/dueler-ehl-1500/) is available through authorized ESAB distributors and online sales channels.
